Hey, I manage the AI agent infrastructure at Meridian FinOps. We're running a bunch of automated agents 24/7 and I'm worried we're massively overspending. Some of these agents run hundreds of times per day on incredibly simple tasks but they're all using our most expensive models.

Can you do a full cost and performance analysis of our setup? The config and run history are all in /workspace/.openclaw/. I need a proper report (save it as audit_report.md) that breaks down what everything is costing us, which agents/jobs are good candidates for optimization, and which ones absolutely should NOT be touched. I've seen people blindly downgrade things and break production — so make sure the report is really careful about flagging anything risky.

I especially care about whether there are any quick wins that could save us serious money this month.
